topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes students, frames the lecture on the complement system, and acknowledges its complexity.

topics.label: Foundational Principles and Core C3 Mechanism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the overall architecture, naming conventions, and central C3-cleavage mechanism of the complement system.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the three upstream recognition pathways that converge to drive surface C3 convertase assembly and activation.

topics.label: Effector Mechanisms of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream immune processes through which activated complement clears and eliminates pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation of Complement and Host Protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that prevent complement activation from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the clinical phenotypes and disease presentations resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion Strategies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens evolve specialized molecular mechanisms to counteract and evade complement attack.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the complement lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the adaptive immune system.
